title: Localize ScheduledDateRow's copy
description: Replace the hardcoded Set for later/Hidden until/Today.../Clear date/Pick Date/Change literals with resource-backed lookups.

The Pick Date/Change button text comes from stringResource(R.string.pick_date_button) / stringResource(R.string.change_button)
No other logic in the function is changed
